home.layout: Top utility bar, orange ministry header with emblem, mega-menu nav, red marquee announcement strip, then a 3-column grid: left citizen-service sidebar, center scheme banners and news tables, right tenders/important-links column.

about.layout: Breadcrumb, page heading, 2-column layout with left sidebar links and right content area containing history paragraphs, organizational chart image, and minister/secretary profile photo tables with bios.

schemes.layout: Breadcrumb, ALL-CAPS heading, filter row, dense full-width data table with zebra striping listing scheme name, launch date, budget, beneficiaries, status badge, and action links.

tenders.layout: Breadcrumb, heading, tab strip for Active/Archived, large data table with tender ID, department, value, deadline, download column, plus a yellow notice box above and pagination below.

contact.layout: Breadcrumb, heading, multi-column office directory table (address/phone/fax/email), embedded map placeholder block, and a bordered grievance registration form with required-field asterisks below.
